ASSIGNMENT 08 · PLOTLY

Interactive screen time, sleep & stress analysis

Explore 15,000 dataset observations through three interactive visualizations. Hover to inspect values, drag to zoom, double-click to reset axes, and filter by occupation and screen-time range.

Interactive controls

1. Screen time versus sleep quality

Scatter plot with individual record tooltips. Look for whether sleep quality falls as daily screen exposure increases.

The full dataset has a strong negative correlation (approximately r = −0.747). The plotted association does not demonstrate causation.

2. Screen time versus stress level

Zoom into clusters and hover to inspect the relationship between daily screen use and reported stress.

The overall association is positive (approximately r = +0.879); occupation and exposure filters let you explore subsets.

3. Average sleep quality by occupation

Interactive bar chart that updates with the same filters. Hover for group averages and sample sizes.

The group averages describe this dataset and do not imply occupational effects.

Interaction and interpretation

Hover: all charts show tooltips. Filter/category selection: choose an occupation. Range selection: limit maximum screen time. Zoom: drag across either scatter plot; double-click to reset. Linked views: changing either filter refreshes all three charts.

Data source: 15,000-row Kaggle screen time, sleep and stress dataset used throughout the research portfolio. The data cover multiple occupations and do not establish that all records represent college students.
